infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Virra reads your workouts, heart rate, and menstrual cycle data from Apple Health to personalise your training plan and nutrition targets to your cycle phase.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Virra writes completed workouts to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Virra uses your location to track your runs. GPS keeps running while your screen is locked during an active run so your route and pace stay accurate.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Virra uses the camera to scan food barcodes for your nutrition log.
